_what: QC gates a variation can carry, with what passes and the automatic check that exists in the workspace today. Stage 6 picks the gates per variation and writes the variation-specific pass line; the machine also adds any gate a route forces (a generated person forces identity drift, an AI clip forces smoothness).

gates.name: Identity / face drift
gates.passes: The generated person matches the cast sheet in every sampled frame; no face melt through the move.
gates.check: tools/video-production gate 5 (still vs cast sheet) on the still; one frame every 0.5 s of the clip through the same check. A per-frame video checker is not built yet.

gates.name: SKU / product accuracy
gates.passes: The product on screen is the SKU the variation names, drawn as the brand's product file describes it; packaging matches the store photo; the SKU on screen is the SKU on any card.
gates.check: video-production gate 4 (QC each still) + the plate check; packaging against the store's product photo.

gates.name: Smoothness — no repeated frames
gates.passes: No held or repeated frames outside a planned hold; every AI clip de-duplicated, interpolated and conformed to the master's fps before it is cut in.
gates.check: ffmpeg mpdecimate / freezedetect scan: repeated frames outside a planned hold = 0. Interpolation local (RIFE). No workspace tool yet — flagged.

gates.name: Seams — chained clips join cleanly
gates.passes: Chained clips were made in order, each starting from the real last frame of the clip before it (never the original still). At every join the frame-to-frame change stays within about 2× the clip's own median frame step. Where a clip could not be made again, an optical-flow bridge over the last ~10 and first ~10 frames closes the join — a repair, recorded as such.
gates.check: Frame-difference scan across each join against the clip's median frame step (ffmpeg, per frame). No workspace tool yet — flagged.

gates.name: Caption and face safe zones
gates.passes: Faces, the product and the hands doing the beat sit inside the centred 4:5 zone of the 9:16 frame; text off faces and clear of the platform's right rail and bottom caption band.
gates.check: tools/video-production/machine/safezone.py (subject 4:5 zone) + tools/video-edit/machine/faces.py (text off the face track).

gates.name: Brand rules
gates.passes: Only bank words on screen and in new lines; the brand's NEVER lists (position.md, story.md, identity-anchors.md) hold; compliance.json small print where a claim is made.
gates.check: tools/video-production/machine/claimfix.py (lines against the product's claim rules) + the NEVER lists checked by text.

gates.name: Doesn't look like an ad
gates.passes: The render keeps the source's camouflage: phone-grade, real rooms, no grade, no logo bug on the organic cut; the triage AI-tells line reads the same as the source's.
gates.check: Re-run video-teardown triage on the render; pass = the same AI ASSESSMENT line as the source.

gates.name: Lip sync
gates.passes: Replaced or re-voiced lines land on the lips within ±0.3 s.

gates.name: Voice
gates.passes: A new voice matches the person's age and gender by ear and is unmuffled.
